bylaws.documentTitle: TLOD, Inc. Constitution and Bylaws (with Dallas Chapter bylaws or SOPs)
bylaws.keeper: Parliamentarian (Lady Shirley Ison-Newsome) and Bylaws Committee (Lady Shirley Ison-Newsome, Lady Karen Parson)

sections.summary: Elected officers serve a two-year administration (2025-2027): President, 1st Vice President, 2nd Vice President, Recording Secretary, Financial Secretary, Treasurer, and Parliamentarian. Confirm the full list of elected offices and term limits.
The Nominating Committee presents a slate of qualified candidates; the Tellers Committee collects, counts, and reports votes. Confirm eligibility rules, timing, and voting method.
Every chapter meeting includes a quorum check before business. Add the quorum number.

Call to order, opening ceremony, agenda, quorum check, meditation, roll call, minutes, correspondence, officer reports, financial and committee reports, unfinished business, new business, announcements, closing ceremony.
Add the parliamentary authority named in the bylaws (for example, Robert's Rules of Order).
The Finance Committee presents the next year's budget at the September chapter meeting and the chapter votes. Add signature, approval, and audit requirements.
New members are sponsored by a Lady in good standing and inducted according to TLOD ritual; the 2025 induction fee was $800. Add eligibility and requirements.
Add annual dues, assessments, deadlines, and what keeps a Lady in good standing.
Chapter meetings are held monthly, usually the third Thursday. Add rules for regular, special, and Executive Board meetings and required notice.
Standing committees include Awards, Bylaws, Finance, Membership, Editor of the Crown, and Scholarship; special committees are formed as needed. Confirm how chairs are appointed.
The Bylaws Committee solicits and proposes changes to the Bylaws and Standard Operating Procedures. Add the notice period and vote required to amend.
Add how officer vacancies are filled and how an officer or member may be removed.
Top Teens follow national Top Teens of America guidelines under the Service to Youth thrust. Add the age range, advisor requirements, and teen officer rules.
